items.text: Raymond James offers loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes; these loans are generally repaid over a five-to-ten year period and are contingent upon continued affiliation with the firm, with any unpaid balance becoming immediately due if the advisor is no longer affiliated.
items.quote: We offer loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes. ... Loans offered are generally repaid over a five -to- ten year period, with interest recognized as earned, and are contingent upon continued affiliation with us. ... In the event that the financial advisor is no longer affiliated with us, any unpaid balance of such loan becomes immediately due and payable to us and generally does not continue to accrue interest.
